name: Curve z-score, contract 1 minus contract 4
license: Calculated from US government series stored in this archive
method: (CL1_MINUS_CL4 minus the train mean) divided by the train population standard deviation. Train mean -0.142 dollars per barrel. Train standard deviation 1.850. Both moments stop at 31 Dec 2019 and are applied to every later print. A positive CL1_MINUS_CL4 means the front NYMEX contract is above the fourth.
